# TradingView Lightweight Charts™

This directory contains an unmodified, vendored copy of
[Lightweight Charts](https://github.com/tradingview/lightweight-charts)
version **5.3.0**, so the query page can draw K-line charts without a CDN.

- Upstream release: https://github.com/tradingview/lightweight-charts/releases/tag/v5.3.0
- File included: `lightweight-charts.standalone.production.mjs`
  (official production standalone ESM build, which already bundles its dependencies)
- License: Apache License, Version 2.0 — see `LICENSE`
- Upstream `NOTICE` — see `NOTICE`

Lightweight Charts is copyright TradingView, Inc., and is used under the Apache-2.0
terms. TradingView Lightweight Charts is a trademark of TradingView, Inc.
